entities.name: Delian League
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Delian League, a political institution in Greece during Classical Athens and the Persian Wars (461 BCE–429 BCE). Grew from Battle of Salamis — decisive Greek naval victory over Xerxes' fleet and Battle of Thermopylae — Leonidas and 300 Spartans' last stand. Led to the emergence of Athenian Empire and Peloponnesian War begins between Athens and Sparta.
